summary: ```# Marvelous Designer Quick Start (2025 Update) - p09: Model Polygon Count Optimization and Retopology Tools In this video, I will show you how to create a 3D model in Marvelous Designer. ## Reversal Function The Reversal function can help your model achieve the ideal line and grid number. In Marvelous Designer, the model is a triangular face model. You can change the grid type and convert it into a four-sided face model with one click. 1. Select the version you want to edit. 2. Right-click the grid type. 3. Here, we choose to optimize the four sides. Your model will be automatically converted into a four-sided model that is close to precision. ### Tips for Four-Sided Optimization **Tip 1:** The four-sided optimization function will move according to the shape of the panel and optimize the layout. It is recommended to prevent the triangular face first. This function is suitable for panels with a large body, sleeves, etc., and not for neat edges. The four-sided grid function will place the panels according to the direction of the 2D interface. **Tip 2:** Prioritize the panel to generate a completely horizontal vertical line. At the edge of the slanted panel and the seam line, it will automatically connect and generate a triangular face. This is suitable for a regular rectangular panel that can be converted into a belt. **Tip 3:** Even if the panel is a regular rectangular panel, it must be placed in the 2D window to properly generate a horizontal vertical grid. **Tip 4:** You can also change the width of the panel. Use the optimization function of Everywhere to optimize the grid number of the model. 1. Click "Connect Everywhere." 2. Enter your target grid number. 3. Press the optimization button. After the grid update is completed, you will observe that the number of grid numbers has decreased. ## Component Material Adjustments In the current version, the component material cannot be four-sided, but you can still adjust the grid number. 1. Click the component column and select the component to be edited. 2. Pull to the bottom and re-fill the number of faces you want. You will see that the grid density has decreased. Alternatively, you can open the plane, and the component model will change to exist in the form of a panel. ### Slope Tool Customization **Tip 1:** You can use the slope tool to customize the slope line of the clothing. Use the smart slope tool to create the slope model you need. **Tip 2:** The corresponding slope model will automatically be created on the mirror panel. **Tip 3:** You can connect multiple slope areas together. **Tip 4:** Finally, press the create button to create a slope. **Tip 5:** Use the edit slope tool to adjust points that do not match the edge. **Tip 6:** The edge of the model will automatically generate black reference points according to the color relationship. **Tip 7:** You can also use the create slope tool to directly create a four-sided slope. **Tip 8:** In the create slope tool mode, press Ctrl and Shift and press a line. The points that do not fit the edge will also be added to the grid. The new points will be added to the black reference points. ## Model Configuration and Size Adjustment In the 2D and 3D windows, you can configure and edit the model as needed. You can also change the size of the model. For example, if you want to change the size of the model, you can adjust the dimensions accordingly. This will determine whether you create a copy or replace the original grid by using the retouching grid. ## Exiting the Network If you want to exit the network, please go to the file menu, select "Exit," and choose OBJ or FBX. In the exit window, you can find the option for merging near the peak. After opening the option, the peak within the range of the set merger will be merged. You can open the display option to check the welding situation of the border peaks. The red highlight indicates the border peaks of the merger, while the blue highlight shows the border peaks of the non-merging merger. Click OK to exit. Thank you for watching. See you next time! ```
